subject: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B Series A at a $6B valuation
text:
Source (primary): https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/toward-more-efficient-ai-leading-flapping-airplanes-1b-series-a/ (21 Oct; source.mjs reads it); mirror https://thenextweb.com/news/flapping-airplanes-1b-6b-valuation
Why it fits: beats 5 and 6, a $1B Series A at a $6B valuation for a year-old AI lab, led by Index and Lux. Take the valuation only from a page that states it. (Filed by Site Watch, relayed by Marc.)
